basis: P2-derived Survey evidence identifies right-opening-2 as the small low opening near the front corner.
P2-derived Survey evidence identifies right-opening-3 as the farther low opening described as glazed or translucent blocks.
Human-established truth identifies the farther low opening as glass blocks and the small low opening as meeting local sidewalk grade.

datum_policy.WALL_DATUM: Fixed architectural wall reference; the low wall paint band does not move with terrain.
datum_policy.TERRAIN_DATUM: Local sidewalk/road grade rises along the right facade from front toward rear.
datum_policy.occlusion_rule: Terrain may progressively occlude an opening but never changes its architectural offset_horizontal, offset_vertical, width, or height.

opening_visual.notes: Human-established glass-block infill on P2. Square glass-block grid is represented visually without asserting a block count or changing the architectural opening rectangle.

evidence.observation: Human-established identification: the farther low right-facade opening is composed of glass blocks; its existing architectural rectangle is retained.

Human-established relation: the small low opening near the front corner reaches the local sidewalk grade. WALL_DATUM remains fixed and distinct from the rising TERRAIN_DATUM; terrain occlusion does not redefine the opening rectangle.
